ENGLISH.KEYWORDS: HOL Guard, AI agent security, local-first, runtime firewall, coding agents
ENGLISH.CHAR_DESC_80: Local-first runtime firewall for AI coding agents (Free plus Cloud)
ENGLISH.CHAR_DESC_250: HOL Guard is a local-first coding-agent runtime firewall from HOL. It can gate shell, secrets/file reads, MCP changes, and plugin/skill installs with local approvals. Free Apache-2.0 core; optional Guard Cloud. Scan is not a safety guarantee.
ENGLISH.CHAR_DESC_450: HOL Guard is a local-first coding-agent runtime firewall by HOL (https://hol.org/guard). On Windows it can gate shell commands, secrets and file reads, MCP registration changes, and plugin or skill installs, with local approvals and receipts. Free Apache-2.0 core; optional Guard Cloud. Scan is not a safety guarantee.
ENGLISH.CHAR_DESC_2000: HOL Guard is a local-first coding-agent runtime firewall from HOL. On Windows it can gate shell commands, secrets and file reads, MCP server registration changes, and plugin or skill installs. Risky actions go through local approvals and receipts. Core is freeware under Apache-2.0. Optional Guard Cloud adds paid sync. Scan is not a safety guarantee. Maker: HOL. Product: https://hol.org/guard. Install: https://hol.org/guard/install.

PERMISSIONS.DISTRIBUTION_PERMISSIONS: The freeware Apache-2.0 version of HOL Guard may be freely distributed unchanged.
